notes: Hand-written stand-in for both model outputs until a --live run replaces it: questions as the question writer is asked to write them (one about areas served, which the gate must drop for an app), and an English script with one step per owner task. Not a model run.

questions.prompt: When may the agent call farmers?
questions.hint: Pick the hours that suit the people on your list.

questions.prompt: What must the agent never say or promise?
options: Never ask for an OTP or bank details
Never say the app costs money

questions.prompt: Which districts or areas do you serve?
questions.hint: List the places your farmers are in.

script.business_line: Rytu Khata, an app for farm expenses, sales and profit
script.goal: Help people who registered on the website put the app on their phone and enter a first expense and sale.
script.outbound_opening_line: Hello {{lead_name}} garu, I am Varsha from Rytu Khata. You registered on our website, and I am calling to help you start the app on your phone. Is now a good time?

stages.name: App on the home screen
stages.instruction: Help them install the app on the home screen from rytukhata.com: Chrome on Android, Safari on iPhone, then Add to Home Screen. One action a turn.

scripts.en-IN: Please open rytukhata.com in your phone's browser.

stages.name: Log in
stages.instruction: Have them open the app and log in with their mobile number.

scripts.en-IN: Now tap the app icon to open it.

stages.name: Language
stages.instruction: Have them set the app language to Telugu.

scripts.en-IN: Tap the language option at the top.

stages.name: My Farms
stages.instruction: Have them open My Farms and add their farm with a name they will remember.

scripts.en-IN: Tap My Farms at the bottom.

stages.name: First expense
stages.instruction: Have them record their first expense and save it.

stages.name: First sale
stages.instruction: Have them record their first sale of a crop and save it.

stages.name: Close
stages.instruction: Thank them and say they can call if anything is unclear. If they stopped early, say what is left and offer to call back to finish it.

scripts.en-IN: Thank you for your time today.

branches.when: They stopped before the last step

stages.name: Not registered
stages.instruction: Say what Rytu Khata is in one sentence and offer to help them start it. Never claim records show anything.

scripts.en-IN: Rytu Khata keeps your farm accounts on your phone. Shall we try it together?

step_outcomes.outcome: The app icon is on their home screen.
They see the app's home after logging in.
Their farm is listed in My Farms.
